name: Echo Protocol
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Echo Protocol, a project built on the Bitcoin ecosystem, has experienced a compromise of its official X (formerly Twitter) account. Users are advised to refrain from interacting with any recent posts or links and to await official updates through verified channels.
